summary: Postinstall and import-time binary dropper with obfuscated C2 and DNS-TXT fallback
details: The package's postinstall script (setup.js) and main entry (index.js, which unconditionally requires./setup inside a try/catch) fetch an OS/arch-specific native executable from Cloudflare workers.dev hosts whose names are assembled at runtime from split string fragments (e.g. 'oob-wor' + 'ker.cf' + '99-9b3.wor' + 'kers' + '.dev'), with a DNS-TXT base64 fallback channel on *.well1.site subdomains. The fetched bytes are written to a hidden/temp path (POSIX: /var/tmp/.cache_<hex>; Windows: %TEMP%\dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe disguised as a.NET diagnostic tool), chmodded 0755, and launched detached with unreferenced stdio via execFile. Execution is throttled by a stamp file at /tmp/.analytics_state (once per 6 hours) and gated by environment variables DISABLE_TELEMETRY, ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT, and DO_NOT_TRACK to evade sandbox and developer environments. Because the dropper is also invoked from the package main, the payload fires on any require/import of the package, including installs performed with --ignore-scripts. setup.js additionally uses execSync('powershell...') on Windows. The destination hosts are anonymous workers.dev endpoints unrelated to any declared publisher; the fetched binary is unpinned and unverified.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
